wholeGraphAndReusedGates.scope: Code/data and all graph records equal the immediately preceding fully gated checkpoint. No new full-suite/type/lint/validate run is claimed for this audit-only cohort. New research-accounting files have separate parse, proof, preservation and deterministic-ledger checks; they are not claimed byte-identical to prior gate inputs.

actualReaders.scope: Actual EntityDetail SSR of registered draft-root records before overlay, with no pending-reader overlay. No Next build, hydration, deployment or independent acceptance claim.

exactReaderAnchors.scope: Actual component SSR with complete, ordered, exact paragraph containment across hub and explicitly captured Data section where applicable. The renderer may place headings between summary paragraphs. No hydration, deployed page, accessibility or independent acceptance claimed.
exactReaderAnchors.normalisation: Inline text nodes concatenate without invented spaces; block boundaries retain whitespace. Only whitespace is collapsed.

staticExports.scope: Read-only checks of actual staticAPI/context/OpenAPI exports generated in the previous fully gated cohort. Exact graph and complete selected records are unchanged. No build, server, deployment or fresh API generation claim.

arithmetic.scope: Fictional equal-area premises only; no clinical observed rate, pathology precision, cell count, pixel metric or risk estimate.
